chapter_label: 2003 / A new way to see the show
description: Our real-time, pixel-accurate visualiser was invented in 2003 to help create shows for Massive Attack and U2, at the beginning of large LED-wall productions.
why_it_matters: That origin still shapes the platform: understand how digital content will work in a physical environment, then bring the creative vision to life.
